Sitemap category file surfaced two additional Home decor nodes NOT in main nav: home-decor/rugs and home-decor/cushions (both live, HTTP 200, but zero-product/empty listings at check time) -- these are textiles regardless of product count, excluded per EXCLUDE 'textiles'; noted, not extracted. Tableware/dinnerware items filed under 'Kitchen & Dining' category per brief convention (matches c174/c176 precedent). 'Mirrors' promoted to its own top-level category (childless, single leaf) matching project convention seen in c173/c174. Qty verification (Rule 1): every leaf page shows an 'N Results' header AND a footer 'Showing X of N results' that agree exactly (both use the same platform pagination/facet-count widget, not the separately-known-inflated Shopify/Magento/Searchspring APIs this project has flagged). Additionally spot-verified the two largest categories via the SFCC Search-UpdateGrid side-door (Rule 2 item 6) with sz=300: Vases returned exactly 137 unique data-pid product tiles (matches header exactly) and Candle holders returned exactly 73 unique data-pid tiles (matches header exactly) -- both exhaustion-confirmed to the exact product-ID level, giving high confidence the header count is not inflated on this platform/site. No room-based navigation found (small single-brand boutique catalogue, flat type-based taxonomy only) so Rule 0.6 room/type dual-tree case does not apply.
